purpose: Fail-closed persistence and independently verifiable finalization for all five scheduled ChatGPT automations.
protocol_invariant: No artifact may claim a persistence step that occurs after that artifact is made immutable.

first_tool_sequence: update heartbeat.json to IN_PROGRESS using fresh content SHA
re-fetch heartbeat.json and verify exact RUN_ID/control_plane_id/automation_id
bootstrap.on_failure: Stop substantive work; attempt minimal Library failure receipt if a writable Library route exists; never claim RUN_PERSISTED.

single_flight.rule: Different RUN_ID heartbeat younger than 50m => DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED. Age 50-75m => AMBIGUOUS_OVERLAP fail closed. Older than 75m => preserve as STRANDED_IN_PROGRESS then new run may start.

requirements: History includes stable RUN_CORE and identifiers but does not claim latest promotion.
Re-fetch history and record returned history blob SHA before pass 10.

sequence: Write/replace latest.json using the same RUN_CORE and RUN_ID, RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, PASSES_COMPLETED=10, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LATEST_VERIFIED_PENDING_RECEIPT, and verified history blob SHA.
Verify same RUN_ID, CONTROL_PLANE_ID, automation_id, lane/branch identity, RUN_CORE semantic equality, and that latest.history_blob_sha equals the actual immutable history blob SHA.

Create immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json with RUN_STATUS=FINALIZATION_VERIFIED, history_blob_sha, latest_blob_sha, verification timestamp, control-plane/automation IDs, and any returned commit SHAs.
Re-fetch finalization receipt and verify both blob SHAs against current history/latest.
Only after receipt verification may heartbeat be updated to IDLE/FINALIZED.
pass_10.acceptance_rule: A v3 run is fully persisted only when latest=RUN_PERSISTED, history exists, and finalization receipt exists and binds the current history/latest blob SHAs.

omega_acceptance.v3: Require valid finalization receipt binding current history/latest blob SHAs.
omega_acceptance.legacy_v2: May accept only pre-v3 migrated runs whose latest/history are directly verified and non-contradictory; classify LEGACY_V2_VERIFIED. Any v2 history whose self-claims conflict with current repo state is QUARANTINED and not accepted.

fallback.on_github_failure: Attempt minimal Library failure receipt containing lane, RUN_ID, timestamp, error, control_plane_id, automation_id; then stop.
fallback.on_library_failure: Emit explicit persistence failure and stop; do not claim RUN_PERSISTED.

watchdog.rule: OMEGA checks latest/history/finalization/heartbeat for all lanes and, when automation registry access exists, compares trigger times to durable repo evidence.

scheduler_truth: automation last_run_time is trigger evidence only, never persistence evidence
